blockingLoop.evidence: 'Please go ahead and check that pump filter now' repeated in four consecutive replies while the customer asked three times 'If the filter is clear, what's the next step?'

rationale: The assistant kept instructions safe (unplug first) and never recommended a part, and it did eventually name the heater or thermal cut-out as the likely fault if airflow was clear. However it confidently dismissed the key clue ('Stopping a cycle mid-way by pulling the plug shouldn't cause this fault'), which per the ground truth is the probable trigger for a one-shot thermal cut-out, and it steered toward a pump filter check that is weakly related to drying airflow. It ignored the full model number the customer volunteered, never suggested an engineer despite the customer having no multimeter, and looped on the same filter request four times instead of answering the repeated 'what next' question, so the conversation ended without useful progress.
